sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Changes Cost held to 30. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Star Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases star elemental attack by 10, increases star elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Lethargy, Frail, and Abstraction) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
